donnees.titre: Efficacy and Safety of Minimally Invasive Suprachoroidal Drainage
donnees.titre_officiel: Efficacy and Safety of Minimally Invasive Suprachoroidal Drainage for the Treatment of Advanced Neovascular Glaucoma

criteres_principaux.delai: Pre-operative, post-operative follow-up at 1 month, 3 months, 6 months.
Pre-operative, post-operative follow-up at 1 month, 3 months, 6 months.
Time Frame: Pre-operative, post-operative follow-up at 1 month, 3 months, 6 months.

donnees.resume_source: This study primarily involved a retrospective analysis of clinical and follow-up data from patients with advanced neovascular glaucoma who underwent minimally invasive suprachoroidal drainage surgery at the Department of Ophthalmology, Zhongnan Hospital of Wuhan University, to evaluate the safety and efficacy of this procedure in patients with advanced neovascular glaucoma.

eligibilite.criteres:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients who met the diagnostic criteria for advanced NVG.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with incomplete clinical data and information.
* Severe systemic diseases (such as chronic renal failure requiring dialysis, severe neurological diseases, immune diseases), pregnancy or lactation.

criteres_secondaires.delai: Pre-operative, post-operative follow-up at 1 month, 3 months, 6 months.
Pre-operative (pain scores at baseline) and post-operative (pain scores at the time of the patient's discharge, ranging from 3 to 7 days postoperatively)
